The '''Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon''' is a cave system that runs underneath [[Miscellania]] and [[Etceteria]]. Both Miscellania and Etceteria have entrances to the dungeon. The Miscellania entrance is closest to the [[Miscellania Expansion|subterranean village]], while the Etceteria entrance is closest to the sea snakes.

The player cannot access the settlement until permitted to enter the dungeon during the quest [[Royal Trouble]]. The full cave system cannot be accessed until after the boss fight of the same quest, although the chamber the [[Giant Sea Snake]] is fought in becomes closed off after the fight.

A [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be set up here to kill the sea snakes, but with reduced effectiveness due to the area being [[single-way combat]].

==History==
Prior to recent times, the cave system was, as its name implies, used as a dungeon, but became neglected due to the lack of need for one. After the events of [[Throne of Miscellania]], people began emigrating to Miscellania and the monarchs of the island began utilising the dungeon to provide shelter for them (one of the reasons given being that no building material was strong enough to withstand the strong winds on the surface of the island). Thus, Miscellania's subterranean expansion project, has resulted in a [[Fremennik]] and [[Dwarf|Dwarven]] settlement.

==Notable features==
The [[Miscellania Expansion]] settlement consists of several shops, those being:

* The [[Miscellanian Clothes Shop]], selling a variety of unique Fremennik and Dwarven clothing.
* The [[Miscellanian Food Shop]], selling mostly common food items.
* The [[Miscellanian General Store]], selling items common to most [[General store|general stores]].
* [[The Esoterican Arms]], a bar selling [[cider]] as one of its drink options.

Directly north of the settlement are a [[bronze pickaxe]] spawn (indicated by a [[Rocks (bronze pickaxe)|rock]] with the option "Take-pickaxe Rocks") and small coal mine, the pickaxes and coal being obtainable by the player and not used in [[Managing Miscellania|Miscellania management]].

The caves also have many [[Sea Snake Hatchling|sea snake hatchlings]] and [[Sea Snake Young|sea snake young]] that the player can fight.
